text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain feels satisfying, but a past gain alone is not a reason to sell; decide based on what I expect going forward.","Avoid letting the pain of selling at a loss keep me invested—losses are part of uncertain markets, and past price moves do not predict future ones.","Frequent checking and trading can tempt me to react to noise, so I should pause and make deliberate choices rather than trade without a clear reason."]}
